about_the_game:
"When cherry blossoms fall upon the Red Cliffs' battlefield,
when katanas clash with Green Dragon Crescent Halberds...
Unleash an epoch-making clash across time and space!"

In this fantastical realm blending auto-chess tactics and roguelike deck-building,
you’ll shatter historical boundaries to command a legendary legion of Three Kingdoms heroes and Sengoku warlords.
Each run sparks a new deck evolution journey—forge irreplicable synergy bonds on procedurally generated battlefields,
and conquer ever-shifting chessboards with your strategic brilliance!

Diverse Character Cards

Collect 100+ uniquely styled cards, each with distinctive skills. Experiment with synergies to build unstoppable decks—the more cards you gather, the more explosive combo strategies you’ll unlock!
(More cards in development—Coming Soon!)

Unlock New Heroes

Command 8 playable heroes, each boasting game-changing mechanics and ultimate abilities.
(Additional heroes underway—Stay Tuned!)

Dynamic Card Market

Acquire cards by conquering brutal challenges or trading in the live-updating marketplace—where buy/sell orders refresh every hour! Strengthen your deck to take on higher difficulties.

Brutal Challenges Await

Battle through 6 escalating difficulty tiers against unpredictable enemy formations. With a scaling power system that infinitely boosts both you and foes, every victory demands sharper tactics.
